accepted.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Retail Trade Policy 2015–20, how many additional jobs were targeted in the retail sector by 2020?
accepted.x: The policy targeted 20,000 additional jobs in the retail sector by 2020.
accepted.tq: Use a direct numerical recall question for the employment target.
accepted.sec: AP Retail Trade Policy 2015-20 - objectives, employment target  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The current Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy is applicable for which period?
accepted.x: The current policy is the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy 2024–29, aligned with Swarna Andhra @2047.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely spaced policy periods.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy 2024–29 is aligned with which long-term vision?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy 2024–29 is aligned with Swarna Andhra @2047.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official title of the associated vision.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy 2024–29:
1. Tourism and hospitality have been accorded industry status across all segments.
2. Tailor-made packages are provided for Mega and Ultra Mega projects.
3. The policy provides only non-fiscal incentives.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The policy provides fiscal, recurring and special incentives in addition to non-fiscal incentives, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the false exclusivity in statement 3 and retain the two supported policy features.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a non-fiscal measure mentioned under the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy?
o: Universal exemption from all statutory clearances
accepted.x: The non-fiscal measures include a single desk, an Investment Facilitation Cell at Vijayawada, an investment tracker and Destination Management Organisations. Universal exemption from all statutory clearances is not provided.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme claim of universal exemption while identifying the listed facilitation measures.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the single-desk mechanism of the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy, how many clearances are specified for the pre-establishment and pre-operation stages respectively?
accepted.x: The single desk covers 13 pre-establishment clearances and 11 pre-operation clearances.
accepted.tq: Separate the two stages before comparing the paired numbers.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy 2024–29?
accepted.x: The Investment Facilitation Cell is located at Vijayawada. The policy also includes an investment tracker and Destination Management Organisations without restricting them to the locations stated in the other options.
accepted.tq: Use the location trap by matching the facilitation body with its specified headquarters.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following targets is associated with the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy?
o: Tourism to contribute over 15% of GVA and 15% of the workforce
Tourism to contribute over 10% of GVA and 10% of the workforce
Tourism to contribute over 25% of GVA and 25% of the workforce
Tourism to contribute over 20% of GVA and 20% of the workforce
accepted.x: The policy targets tourism exceeding 20% of the State GVA and 20% of the workforce.
accepted.tq: Match the paired percentage targets without reversing the two indicators.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy aims to place Andhra Pradesh among which group of destinations in India?
accepted.x: One of the policy targets is to make Andhra Pradesh one of India’s top three destinations.
accepted.tq: Test the exact rank target using nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Budget hotels were promoted in Andhra Pradesh mainly with which objective?
o: To restrict private investment in tourism
To provide accommodation exclusively to government employees
accepted.x: Budget hotels were promoted mainly to attract tourists by expanding affordable accommodation facilities.
accepted.tq: Identify the practical tourism objective rather than an absolute or exclusionary claim.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following developments was reported in 2026 in relation to Andhra Pradesh tourism?
o: Swarna Andhra Tourism Vision 2047 was unveiled at the FAITH conclave.
The State withdrew from all national tourism schemes.
All beach tourism projects were cancelled.
The tourism policy was discontinued before 2024.
accepted.x: Swarna Andhra Tourism Vision 2047 was unveiled at the FAITH conclave in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the genuine current-affairs development from sweeping negative claims.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh won the ‘Best Tourism Promotion State’ award at GTM 2026.
2. A draft MICE policy was proposed for Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada.
3. Swarna Andhra Tourism Vision 2047 was unveiled at the FAITH conclave.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Andhra Pradesh received the GTM 2026 award, a draft MICE policy was proposed for Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada, and the tourism vision was unveiled at the FAITH conclave.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option when all three current tourism developments are supported.
accepted.sec: AP Tourism Policy - period, industry status, incentives, budget hotels  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the national tourism schemes:
1. Swadesh Darshan develops thematic circuits.
2. PRASHAD develops pilgrimage sites.
3. Swadesh Darshan 1.0 had 76 projects sanctioned in January 2015.
4. Of those 76 projects, 75 had been completed.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Swadesh Darshan focuses on thematic circuits, PRASHAD on pilgrimage sites, and Swadesh Darshan 1.0 had 76 sanctioned projects, of which 75 were completed.
accepted.tq: Combine scheme functions with the numerical completion record before selecting the inclusive option.
accepted.sec: Central tourism schemes in AP - Swadesh Darshan, PRASHAD, Buddhist circuit

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the national project position under the tourism schemes?
accepted.x: Swadesh Darshan 2.0 had 52 projects, while PRASHAD had 54 projects sanctioned nationally.

accepted.sec: Central tourism schemes in AP - Swadesh Darshan, PRASHAD, Buddhist circuit

accepted.s: The national PRASHAD programme had how many projects with a total outlay of ₹1,726.74 crore?

accepted.sec: Central tourism schemes in AP - Swadesh Darshan, PRASHAD, Buddhist circuit
